athlete.bio: A fierce competitor with an unyielding spirit, this infielder blends agility and strategy, thrilling fans with her quick reflexes and sharp instincts. Off the field, her infectious enthusiasm inspires teammates.

caption:
A few months ago, I made the decision to read the Bible in a year. I bought a new Bible, a journal, pens, highlighters, and a Bible in a year guide. I made the conscious effort of reading it every day. I was spending every day trying, longing, and wishing to feel Him the way everyone else does in their testimonies. But still, I couldn’t. I know now that it wasn’t on MY timing, it was on HIS. 

This past weekend I went to the national convention with campus outreach. I always had considered myself a Christian, but never fully committed to Him and His plan for me. I wasn’t walking in the way of Christ. I was sinning without any conviction. I was stubborn, unforgiving, judgmental, angry, and so much more. I wasn’t loving others the way he so freely loves us. Yet, I still thought that just because I believed in Jesus, I was fine. 

I had been searching for something, but didn’t truly commit to Him. After learning a ton about the Lord, His plans, and His mission, a light went off in my head and my heart began to soften. I opened up to a few girls I met on the trip and was more vulnerable with them than anyone before. I confessed so much that had was weighing on my heart and mind. Then one of them asked me this question- “Have you ever actually accepted Christ in your heart and given your life to Christ?”. I had never been asked such a tough question; I answered and confessed that I hadn’t. They prayed over me and I gave everything to God and begged him to save me. I was sobbing. Then suddenly, my tears pouring out of my eyes came to a halt and I no longer even had the feeling that I was going to start crying again. I felt a sense of relief and a feeling of calmness I had NEVER experienced before. THIS is what it felt like to feel Him and His presence. Everything was lifted off my shoulders. It all made sense. If you would’ve told me that I wasn’t truly walking with God, I would’ve gotten defensive, angry, and resentful toward you. But this is EXACTLY what I needed to hear. I am a sinner in need of a savior, and I am SO happy to say that I have given my life to Christ! I gave him complete control of my life and I’m letting Him lead me. My heart is on FIRE for Jesus!!!

Everyone’s watching the shot.
Waiting on the result.
Judging the outcome.

We do this with other people all the time.
We slow-motion their moments.
We sit back asking, “Did he make it?”

But life doesn’t always show you the make or the miss right away.

Sometimes the shot is still in the air.
Sometimes the work is happening where nobody can see it.
Sometimes all that’s visible is the effort, not the outcome.

Most people quit because they want instant confirmation.
Growth doesn’t work like that.

I’m going to make it.

LA DUEÑA DE LA MULTICOLOR

Bianca Garibaldi es la gran joya del vóley argentino actual, destacándose como una central dominante tanto en la Selección como en el exterior. Su carrera dio un salto clave al integrarse a Georgia Tech en los Estados Unidos, donde se ha consolidado como una de las mejores bloqueadoras de la liga universitaria (NCAA), recibiendo distinciones en el equipo ideal de su región.
​Con la Selección Argentina, Bianca representa el recambio generacional de "Las Panteras". Su impacto fue total en el Mundial Sub-21, donde fue elegida como la mejor en su puesto, demostrando una altura y lectura de juego que la proyectan como una referente histórica. Su combinación de potencia física y experiencia internacional la convierte en el pilar defensivo sobre el cual se construye el futuro del voley nacional.

Since 2016, @georgiatechfb players have worked with @upliftingathletes to harness the power of sport to make a positive impact in the rare disease community. On November 6, we were proud to host our largest group yet—15 strong—for a special Uplifting Experience practice visit.

From facility tours to sideline smiles, this milestone was made possible by the trust of our rare community and the generosity of the Georgia Tech athletic staff. The team went above and beyond to make every kid and parent feel welcomed. As much as we touched their lives, they touched ours too.

Huge thanks to everyone who helped make this moment happen, including chapter leaders Joe Fusile, Malachi Hosley, Ronnie Thomas, UA’s MaKaylie Peterkin, and Georgia Tech Football staff Anthony Parker, Amanda Skipwith, LaMiles Brooks, Jaimie Rainone, and many more.

Here’s to more moments like this 💛💙 #WeTackleRare

caption:
Blessed is an understatement. I never imagined I’d ever hang up my childhood cleats and take a step into something new. It’s scary, but more than anything, I’m overwhelmed with gratitude. The mentors I’ve learned from, the LIFE LONG friendships I’ve built, the forever family I found through travel ball—I wouldn’t trade it for anything.

To my coaches, thank you for believing in me, pushing me, and giving me a journey I’ll never forget. To my parents, you’ve been my rock since day one, and I wouldn’t be here without your constant love and support.

If travel ball gave me anything, it was memories that will last a lifetime, relationships that shaped me, and the confidence to look younger me in the eyes and say she did it. A young black girl from a small town made it, even with all the eyes watching and all the words doubting. And she did it her way.

24 signing out, forever blessed

Craft leads the RedHawks with 83 triples on the season, a total that ranks him second all-time in single-season three-point field goals made in Miami history. He erupted for a career-high 40 points (13-of-22 from the field) in a victory over Toledo and shot 10-of-16 from the three-point line in a win against Bethany, tying Jason Stewart (10 vs. Marshall in 2000) for the most made threes in program history.

caption:
october 28, 2024. that morning, i woke up expecting to be telling you happy birthday, and you reaching another milestone, a 55th birthday. instead, i never got that chance. it still doesn’t feel real, and every minute i’m just thinking you will come back or call me just to have our usual conversations. i never could see it until now that you’re gone, but Dad, you are my hero. you seemed superhuman, invincible. you showed me what it’s like to be a man and a leader, and nobody else could’ve done a better job. you did everything you possibly could to help me reach my dreams & goals, and you did the same for every one of your kids and all of those around you. you did so much for so many people and kids around the world, and i just want you to rest knowing myself and all of my siblings will carry on your & Pops legacy, the Mustaf Legacy. i thank God for giving me you as a father and allowing me to experience your unconditional love. i hope you know i love you just as much as you loved me. i miss you so much already man, but now i got a season to play and a career to chase, so just know i’m going to accomplish EVERYTHING we’ve ever talked about. get your rest Dad, we’ll hold it down. i love you. Rest in Peace, GOAT ❤️.

#mustaflegacy

Izgatott vagyok hogy bejelenthetem a szóbeli elhatározásomat a Georgia Tech iránt a 2025-os szezontól kezdve. Nagyon hálás vagyok ezért az ajánlatért hiszen ez egy nem mindennapi lehetőség számomra. Köszönettel tartozom a családomnak amiért egész életemben támogattak és ott voltak mellettem. Szeretném megköszönni az egész @vasasvolleyball -nak, akiket immár a második családomnak mondhatok, a támogatást és a bizalmat, nélkülük biztosan nem tartanék ott ahol most. Köszönöm az edzőimnek hogy mindig a legjobbat próbálták kihozni belőlem és a csapattársaimnak hogy a nehéz napokon is átsegítettek. Külön köszönet Michellenek, Claudionak és Vininek hogy hisznek bennem és nagyon izgatott vagyok hogy elkezdjük a közös munkát! Tudom hogy még nagy út áll előttem, és remélem hogy egy igazán jó szezont fogok tudni zárni a klub csapatommal hogy aztán nagy lendülettel tudjak csatlakozni a @gtvolleyball csapatához, jövő évtől kezdve. 

I am so excited to announce my verbal commitment to Georgia Tech. I am very grateful for this offer, as it is a special opportunity for me. I am grateful to my family for supporting me throughout my life and being there for me. I would like to thank the whole @vasasvolleyball , who I can now call my second family, for their support and trust, without them I would definitely not be where I am now. I thank my coaches for always trying to get the best out of me and my teammates for helping me through the difficult days. Special thanks to Michelle, Claudio and Vini for believing in me and I am very excited to start working together! I know that I still have a long way to go and I hope that I will be able to finish a really good season with my club team so that I can join the @gtvolleyball team with great enthusiasm, starting next year. #stingem🐝

caption:
Ciao Titu, ti scrivo dal posto in cui tutto è cominciato
Dove ci siamo viste per la prima volta
Quando da lontano mi fulminasti con quel tuo sguardo tagliente che sulla la tua facciata rude e diffidente mi spaventò, incuriosendomi allo stesso tempo
Mi trovo nel posto dove ci siamo conosciute sul serio e abbiamo stretto il nostro legame indissolubile
Quanto sei speciale
Come hai potuto dimenticartene
Avevi un mondo dentro che viaggiava alla velocità della luce, pronto ad esplodere
Un mondo tanto caotico quanto fragile
Proteggevi il tuo cuore tenero con una corazza spessissima e impenetrabile
Pochi hanno avuto il privilegio di conoscere la parte più autentica, affettuosa e vulnerabile di te
Perché quando abbassavi le difese e davi alle persone la possibilità di avvicinarsi, rivelavi il tuo spirito puro, dolce, premuroso, innocente
Semplicemente straordinaria
Semplicemente Titu
Tu che con la tua brillante personalità e col tuo senso dell’umorismo travolgente, anche  nelle routine più pesanti, riuscivi a strappare sorrisi
Il bicchiere sempre mezzo pieno
Non ti facevi abbattere da alcun tipo di circostanza
Non importa quanto gli ostacoli apparissero insormontabili, dargliela vinta era fuori discussione
E poi di stronzate ne abbiamo fatte tante eh: tu che non avevi mai paura delle conseguenze e io che mi cagavo in mano…finiva sempre con te che cercavi di tranquillizzarmi 
Mi hai insegnato il senso del duro lavoro, della perseveranza, della motivazione, della resilienza
Si sa eri dotata, talentuosa…ma la verità è che non hai mai smesso di farti un culo immenso dal giorno 0
Non ti lamentavi mai
Quanto sudore che hai versato
Quanta anima che hai messo nel nostro sport
Eri un esempio per me, un pilastro, un punto di riferimento…una sorella maggiore
